protocol: User-corrected operational task: ignore harmless gravel; propose substantial raised rocks/bedrock blocks; explicitly identify rover equipment. Visually reviewed native PDS polygons, not independent expert truth or metric height labels. Unknown remains 255; boundary band excluded. Rover polygons take foreground occlusion precedence, without declaring the hidden ground free. Train episodes use old training acquisition groups or later dedicated training sols; validation/test episodes and physical scenes are separate. Sol71 excluded because it repeats the Sol82 rock cluster. Navigation must still confirm physical dimensions from actual stereo, never from apparent pixel size alone. Version2: manually reviewed ground ROIs and sky regions constrain full-image false positives. Listed substantial object polygons override ground; hardware overrides visible foreground occlusions. A 10-native-pixel uncertain collar around object/hardware boundaries remains ignored. Ambiguous regions stay unknown. This is not automatic filling of unreviewed scenes. Version3 adds six manually reviewed training views and corrects Rocknest sampling marks using actual XYZ and NASA context. Candidate rock labels do not assert that a visually prominent rock exceeds a metric risk threshold; route blockage additionally requires physical stereo evidence. Validation and test source scenes are unchanged. See stereo audit for bounded measurement evidence. Version4 completes the visible front face of the Sol3200 training block before the final refinement; no heldout predictions were used. Known Jake boulder demo frame is operational-head training only; the frozen terrain head and sealed expert test remain separate. It is not a heldout generalisation example. Version5: thirteen additional native scenes individually traced before model predictions. Broad flat bedrock, rover shadows and obvious tiny gravel are ground; raised blocks and detached substantial visual rocks are candidates, ambiguous slabs remain unknown. Prior two test scenes are consumed_audit after a poor precision result and cannot serve as fresh test. New roles were fixed before predictions; data/annotations/operational-v5-review-protocol.json records them. Coordinates manually read at 512 preview and converted to native1024; boundary uncertainty retained. This is visual review by the coding assistant, not independently expert truth or a metric height assertion. Full1024 second-pass label QA corrected preview-coordinate errors and completed block faces BEFORE training/predictions; ambiguous dark strata excluded explicitly. Draft review generator is not authoritative; this final JSON is.
